correctness.rationale: The generator and Lyapunov drift on total occupancy imply a unique positive-recurrent law with finite second moments. Its three stationary mean/factorial/mixed balances form a nonsingular linear system, whose exact solution reduces to both stated variance expressions. Exact differentiation identifies the clearing derivative as a strictly positive factor times a strictly decreasing cubic, with positive value at zero and negative value at the death rate; this proves a unique global optimum. The strictly positive hopping derivative and limits follow from the same rational formula. Conditional mean closure establishes the time-lag covariance identity. A 68-assertion standalone program checked symbolic identities and independent finite-chain approximations; the finite-chain checks are not the infinite-state proof.

value.rationale: This exact two-site problem is directly motivated by independent catastrophic site clearing coupled to hopping, as studied in local-reset zero-range particle physics. The stationary product-Poisson benchmark has zero instantaneous cross covariance; independent local catastrophe clocks instead produce a strict positive cross covariance, measurable overdispersion, and an injection-independent amplitude ratio. A unique optimal reset-rate window below the individual-death rate distinguishes the competition between synchronization through migration and depletion through clearing. The exact physical dependence is not a mere relabeling of a single-site moment formula; it resolves a naturally defined cross-fluctuation question absent from the inspected mean-field analysis.
